title: UCL 2026: PSG sink Barcelona 4-2; Liverpool recover late to secure 4-3 win
description:
Paris Saint-Germain was too powerful for even Lamine Yamal's magic as it ended Barcelona's 11-game winning run to top the Champions League table.
A thrilling end to the game with four goals in the last 20 minutes delivered a statement win for PSG, which is joined Liverpool as the only teams with three victories after Alexis Mac Allister led a rousing 4-3 comeback triumph over Villarreal on Tuesday.
Yamal had just displayed stunning skill to level the score at 2-2 from a narrow angle when PSG took the lead again through Vitinha, before Fabian Ruiz added another for a 4-2 victory.
"We never feel like we're powerless, or that we're beaten in any way," PSG forward Desire Doue said. "We always know there's an opportunity as long as the final whistle hasn't gone,"
Injuries to stars Ousmane Dembele and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia took some of the shine off the win for PSG, which could now face having to cope without two of its biggest difference-makers in attack.
Barcelona needs to bounce back
